news.title: 8 ways that U.S.-style democracy stands out globally
news.summary_en: As the U.S. celebrates the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence this year, here are eight ways its political system stands apart from the world’s other 105 democracies.

news.title: Majority of Americans support banning social media for kids under 16
news.summary_en: Across major demographic and partisan groups, more Americans support than oppose banning those under 16 from using social media.

news.title: 5% of Americans say they’ve ridden in a driverless car
news.summary_en: Regardless of whether they’ve ridden in one before, most Americans (71%) say they would be not too or not at all comfortable riding in a driverless car.

news.title: About a third of U.S. Democrats like political leaders who identify as democratic socialists
news.summary_en: Democrats’ views on democratic socialists also differ by race and ethnicity, age, education, income and political engagement.

news.title: 5 facts about religion in the Philippines
news.summary_en: Nearly all Filipinos believe in God, most pray daily and 92% identify as Christian, with Catholics as the majority.

news.title: Which Americans are most likely to have spoken with a local journalist?
news.summary_en: About a quarter of Americans have spoken with a local journalist, with education, income, race and community attachment linked to higher rates of interaction.
